record.learning: When a scanner whitelists sidecar IO by declared runtime, keep every accepted runtime usable by allowing only its bounded stdio surface on the declared sidecar entrypoint.
evidence: CAS footgun-finder 019f3085-cb85-79d2-bfca-c64bf241abfe found Deno was accepted by validateSidecarCommand but Deno stdio was unconditionally rejected; bun test and bun run proof passed after harness/pack-utils.mjs and test/adapter_self_containment.test.mjs fix.
record.application: For future sidecar runtime changes, update runtime validation, self-containment allowlists, docs, and entrypoint-bound regressions together.

record.learning: When a capability adapter duplicates manifest policy fields, prefer a verifier parity check that requires adapter manifest() to expose and match the full enforced policy surface, including secrets, because otherwise verified packs can drift and reject callers that followed the published manifest.
evidence: Post-fix footgun CAS 019f30b2-1490-7541-a184-70342b36639d found verified packs could still drift between manifest and adapter policy fields; verifyPack parity checks plus adapter secretRequirements exposure fixed it with bun test and bun run proof passing.
record.application: For future pack policy changes, update adapter manifest(), manifest.json, checksums, pack fingerprints, and verifier parity tests together before review-closeout.
